newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SOCCER SHOWCASE-ANDERLECHT V EKEREN TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-ANDERLECHT V EKEREN TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Sunday's Belgian Cup final between Anderlecht and Ekeren at the King Baudouin stadium:

Anderlecht: 1-Geert De Vlieger, 2-Tibor Selymes, 4-Celestine Babayaro, 12-Olivier Doll, 14-Samuel Johnson, 18-Suad Katana, 5-Johan Walem, 11-Danny Boffin, 13-Bruno Versavel, 10-Par Zetterberg, 22-Oleg Yaschuk

Ekeren: 1-Philippe Vande Walle, 2-Bernard Wegria, 6-Mike Verstraeten, 7-Rudi Janssens, 8-Florian Urban, 9-Didier Dheedene, 15-Marc Schaessens, 10-Gunther Hofmans, 14-Christophe Kinet, 12-Edwin Van Ankeren, 13-Tomasz Radzinski.
